verdict.rationale: Jira's Rovo AI automation features (jira-docs-4, jira-docs-13) reference creating rules for reminders and moving work forward, implying some automation/workflow capability, but there is no explicit evidence of scheduled or recurring job triggers (e.g., cron-like scheduling) documented in this evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/recurring triggers, API/CLI examples for setting up recurring automations, and independent confirmation that AI-native users can programmatically schedule workflows.
